summary: RunPod's Startup Program Starter Tier gives accepted earlier-stage startups $1,000 in credits usable across Pods, Serverless, Clusters, Public Endpoints, and Storage, with self-serve onboarding. The program is selective; venture backing is strongly preferred; it is primarily for new customers. The separate Growth Tier is not a free grant: you deposit $50,000 and receive $25,000 in bonus credits.
claim_steps: Confirm fit: earlier-stage startup with real AI workloads (venture-backed preferred; new RunPod customers primarily).
Apply via the Startup Program page (selective; not every applicant is accepted).
If accepted into Starter Tier, use the $1,000 credits across Pods, Serverless, Clusters, Endpoints, or Storage.
Do not treat Growth Tier as free credits — that tier requires a $50,000 upfront commit.

social_proof.title: Startup Program | Runpod
social_proof.text: Starter Tier: Get $1,000 in credits to get started on Runpod with full platform access and self-serve onboarding. Flexible: use credits however fits your workload. Growth Tier: Load $50,000 and get $25,000 in bonus credits.
